description: This file defines the public interface for managing modules within the FreeType library, including module flags, class structures, and functions for adding, retrieving, and removing modules, as well as creating and destroying library instances.

classes.name: FT_Module_Class
classes.description: Descriptor for a FreeType module class, including flags, size, name, version, required FreeType version, interface, and lifecycle functions.

methods.name: FT_Add_Module
methods.description: Adds a new module to a FreeType library instance.

methods.name: FT_Get_Module
methods.description: Retrieves a module by its name from a FreeType library.

methods.name: FT_Remove_Module
methods.description: Removes a specified module from a FreeType library.

methods.name: FT_New_Library
methods.description: Creates a new FreeType library instance with a specified memory object.

methods.name: FT_Done_Library
methods.description: Discards a FreeType library instance, closing all drivers and resources.

methods.name: FT_Set_Debug_Hook
methods.description: Sets a debug hook function for the font interpreter.

methods.name: FT_Add_Default_Modules
methods.description: Adds the default set of modules to a FreeType library instance.
